item.name: Time To Grow Up
item.trigger: After being hit
item.effectSummary: Increases the duration of the speed boost after a hit.
item.cardSummary: Time To Grow Up is a simple chase safety perk for surviving the first hit. It helps when you need a little more post-hit distance before the killer can pressure again.

item.name: Great Collapse
item.trigger: Stun the killer with a pallet
item.effectSummary: Rewards a pallet stun with a short speed burst, then applies Winded.
item.cardSummary: Great Collapse turns a good pallet stun into an escape window. It fits survivors who fight back at loops, but Winded keeps it from chaining into constant speed boosts.

item.name: Left Behind
item.trigger: Escape gates powered
item.levelValues: 5/6/7% speed boost until the round ends
item.effectSummary: Gives a permanent endgame speed boost once gates are powered.
item.cardSummary: Left Behind is built for the final escape stretch. It does nothing early, but it becomes useful when gates are powered and every second of distance matters.

item.name: Quick Recovery
item.trigger: Fast or medium vault a window
item.levelValues: 40% speed boost for 3 seconds; Winded 70/60/50 seconds
item.effectSummary: Adds a short speed burst after a window vault and then applies Winded.
item.cardSummary: Quick Recovery rewards clean window routing. It is strongest when the vault actually creates distance, because the Winded timer blocks another activation for a while.

item.name: Snake Step
item.trigger: While crouched
item.cooldownOrLimit: Aura block has a 45 second cooldown
item.effectSummary: Blocks killer aura reveal while crouched and greatly increases crouch speed.
item.cardSummary: Snake Step is a stealth perk for hiding from aura reads without crawling across the map. It helps patient survivors reposition while crouched instead of sprinting into chase.

item.name: We're Stronger Together
item.trigger: Stay within 15 studs of another survivor
item.levelValues: 4/5/6% speed boost for survivors in range
item.effectSummary: Grants a small speed boost to nearby survivors when grouped.
item.cardSummary: We're Stronger Together is for team movement, rescues, and grouped pressure. It loses value when everyone splits up, but it helps a tight group move faster around danger.

item.name: Against All Odds
item.trigger: Heal a survivor in dying state
item.effectSummary: Speeds up healing on downed survivors and reveals the killer aura.
item.cardSummary: Against All Odds is a rescue-focused healing perk. It is best when your team needs someone who can pick up downed survivors quickly while still tracking the killer.

item.name: Ambitious Medic
item.trigger: Land a great skill check while injured
item.levelValues: 2 healing charges recovered; 40% more skill checks
item.cooldownOrLimit: Healing skill checks rotate 40% slower if both survivors use it
item.effectSummary: Rewards great healing skill checks with recovered progress and more frequent skill checks.
item.cardSummary: Ambitious Medic is for players comfortable with healing skill checks. It can recover progress, but it also changes the rhythm of healing when both survivors bring it.

item.name: Enhanced Touch
item.trigger: Finish a heal action you started on another survivor
item.effectSummary: After a completed heal, gives the healed survivor better healing, repairing, and movement for a short time.
item.cardSummary: Enhanced Touch makes a completed heal create momentum. It fits support players who want the healed teammate to get back to objectives or reposition faster.

item.name: Grab My Hand
item.trigger: After you unspike a survivor
item.effectSummary: Gives a large healing speed boost after rescuing a spiked survivor.
item.cardSummary: Grab My Hand turns an unspike into a fast reset window. It is useful when your team can rescue first and heal immediately after the killer leaves.

item.name: Nobody Left Behind
item.trigger: Escape gates powered
item.effectSummary: Reveals every survivor and improves healing and unspiking when gates are powered.
item.cardSummary: Nobody Left Behind is an endgame rescue perk. It helps find teammates and speed up saves when the exit phase turns chaotic.

item.name: Pacifist
item.trigger: Always active
item.levelValues: 20% base healing boost; +5/7/10% per missing survivor
item.effectSummary: Gives a permanent healing speed boost that grows when survivors are missing.
item.cardSummary: Pacifist is steady healing value with better late-round scaling. It fits players who want a simple support perk that does not need a special trigger.

item.name: Absolute Confidence
item.trigger: While you are in chase
item.cooldownOrLimit: Only helps while you are chased
item.effectSummary: When chased, nearby survivors gain action speed and have their aura revealed to you.
item.cardSummary: Absolute Confidence makes your chase useful for teammates. It is strongest when you can keep the killer busy while nearby survivors work objectives.

item.name: Call Me Back
item.trigger: A survivor you healed gets hit
item.effectSummary: Reveals a healed survivor after the killer hits them.
item.cardSummary: Call Me Back helps support players keep track of someone they recently healed. It is useful when a teammate gets pressured again before the team can fully reset.

item.name: Debut Showcase
item.trigger: Parry, stun, or blind the killer
item.effectSummary: Reveals the killer to every survivor after you interrupt them.
item.cardSummary: Debut Showcase turns a good defensive play into team information. It works best with survivors who already use parries, pallet stuns, or blinds well.

item.name: Eyes of Heaven
item.trigger: Always active nearby
item.levelValues: Pallet and window aura range 80/90/100 studs
item.effectSummary: Reveals pallets and windows in a nearby radius.
item.cardSummary: Eyes of Heaven helps newer loopers find routes before panic sets in. It is a comfort pick for learning where pallets and windows are during a chase.

item.name: Flawless Execution
item.trigger: Hit consecutive great skill checks while repairing alone
item.levelValues: 3/4/5% repair boost; extra +1/2/3% after third great check; 8/10/12s return window
item.effectSummary: Rewards solo generator great skill-check streaks with repair speed, but the streak ends on a miss.
item.cardSummary: Flawless Execution is for objective players who can hit great skill checks. It can speed up solo repairs, but mistakes reset the value.

item.name: Heads Up
item.trigger: Killer gets within 50 studs
item.cooldownOrLimit: Does not activate while Winded; applies Winded for 40 seconds
item.statusEffect: Sound cue; killer aura reveal; speed boost; Winded
item.effectSummary: Warns you when the killer is close, reveals them, and gives a short speed boost.
item.cardSummary: Heads Up is an early-warning perk for avoiding surprise hits. It helps you leave an unsafe spot, but Winded stops it from repeating too often.

item.name: Hearing Aid
item.trigger: Killer breaks a pallet or damages a generator within 240 studs
item.effectSummary: Reveals the killer after they break or damage an objective nearby.
item.cardSummary: Hearing Aid converts killer noise into information. It is useful when the killer is pressuring nearby loops or generators and you need to know where they moved.

item.name: Last Stand
item.trigger: Escape gates powered
item.statusEffect: Soul state heal; killer aura reveal
item.effectSummary: When gates are powered, heals a soul state and reveals the killer.
item.cardSummary: Last Stand is a late-round safety perk for the gate phase. It helps you recover and see the killer when the match is close to ending.

item.name: On My Own
item.trigger: You are the last survivor alive
item.statusEffect: Killer aura reveal; opening speed boost
item.effectSummary: As the last survivor, reveals the killer and speeds up opening for an escape attempt.
item.cardSummary: On My Own is a clutch perk for the final survivor. It has no value while the team is alive, but it can make the last escape attempt more realistic.

item.name: Perfectionist Planning
item.trigger: Closest unrepaired generators revealed
item.levelValues: Aura reveal to others for 35/45/55 seconds
item.statusEffect: Generator aura reveal; repair speed change
item.effectSummary: Highlights the three closest unrepaired generators and rewards repairing them faster.
item.cardSummary: Perfectionist Planning points you toward a generator route. It is good for objective players, but it punishes ignoring the highlighted generators.

item.name: Visual Learner
item.trigger: Generators completed, then fast vault a window
item.cooldownOrLimit: Needs generator tokens and a fast vault
item.statusEffect: Extended aura duration; killer aura reveal
item.effectSummary: Improves aura visibility and spends generator-earned tokens on killer aura reveals after fast vaults.
item.cardSummary: Visual Learner is an information perk with a setup step. It rewards objective progress first, then gives chase information when you vault.

item.name: Familiar Soul
item.trigger: Nearby survivors
item.effectSummary: Reveals nearby survivor auras so you can find teammates more easily.
item.cardSummary: Familiar Soul is simple team awareness. It helps support players find teammates for heals, rescues, or grouped objective pressure.

item.name: Built Different
item.trigger: Heal up from dying state
item.effectSummary: Grants Endurance after healing from dying state and allows one self-pickup per round.
item.cardSummary: Built Different is a recovery perk for surviving after a down. The one-time self-pickup makes it valuable, but timing still matters after you stand up.

item.name: Desperate
item.trigger: After being picked up by the killer
item.effectSummary: Gives instant wiggle progress when the killer picks you up.
item.cardSummary: Desperate is for players who want a better chance to escape a carry. It is narrow, but the trigger matters when the killer is trying to spike you.

item.name: Flowstate
item.trigger: Fast window vault while active
item.effectSummary: Makes a fast window vault quicker with a special animation, then goes on cooldown.
item.cardSummary: Flowstate is a clean chase perk for window routes. It helps when one faster vault can deny a hit, but it needs a real window path to matter.

item.name: Group Project
item.trigger: Repair the same generator with other survivors
item.levelValues: 3/5/7% repair speed per survivor on the same generator
item.cooldownOrLimit: Does not stack with itself from multiple users
item.effectSummary: Boosts generator repair speed for grouped survivors and shares the effect.
item.cardSummary: Group Project rewards teaming on the same generator. It can push an objective faster, but duplicate users do not stack the perk.

item.name: High Karma
item.trigger: After you unspike another survivor
item.effectSummary: After rescuing someone, lets you self-unspike once later but applies anti-heal afterward.
item.cardSummary: High Karma rewards making the first rescue. It can save you later, but the anti-heal drawback means the self-save is not a free full reset.

item.name: Intense Workout
item.trigger: Unspike a survivor
item.levelValues: 40/45/50% faster unspike; 10% speed boost for 8 seconds
item.effectSummary: Speeds up unspiking and gives the rescued survivor a short speed boost.
item.cardSummary: Intense Workout is a rescue tempo perk. It makes the unspike faster and helps the saved survivor move away before pressure returns.

item.name: Iron Tranquility
item.trigger: While on the spike
item.levelValues: Blood pool lifetime reduced by 3/4/5 seconds
item.effectSummary: Hides your aura while spiked and shortens the lifetime of your blood pools.
item.cardSummary: Iron Tranquility makes you harder to track while spiked. It is defensive value for players who expect the killer to camp information around rescue states.

item.name: No Pain No Gain
item.trigger: Always active with permanent injury
item.effectSummary: Trades permanent injury for self-recovery, no blood pools, and faster recovery speed.
item.cardSummary: No Pain No Gain is a risky self-recovery perk. It removes blood pools and lets you recover yourself, but permanent injury makes every chase more dangerous.

item.name: On Screen Fear
item.trigger: Inside terror radius but not in chase
item.effectSummary: Gives small movement and action boosts while near the killer but not being chased.
item.cardSummary: On Screen Fear rewards staying productive near danger. It is useful when the killer is close, but it drops in value once you are actually in chase.

item.name: Partners In Crime
item.trigger: Two survivors stay in terror radius for 15 seconds while not in chase
item.levelValues: Up to 3 tokens; 2/3/4% repair speed per token
item.cooldownOrLimit: Lose a token every 25 seconds while not repairing and lose one when entering chase
item.effectSummary: Builds repair-speed tokens with a nearby teammate inside terror radius, then loses tokens when pressure changes.
item.cardSummary: Partners In Crime is a duo objective perk. It rewards staying calm near the killer, but chase pressure or time away from repairs burns the tokens down.

item.name: Second Wind
item.trigger: After you are unspiked
item.effectSummary: Extends Endurance after another survivor unspikes you.
item.cardSummary: Second Wind helps after a rescue, especially against repeat pressure. It does not prevent the spike, but it gives more time to escape after the save.

item.name: All Seeing Eye
item.trigger: Two survivors work one generator for 5 seconds
item.statusEffect: Loud noise notification; generator aura reveal
item.effectSummary: Alerts the killer and reveals the generator when two survivors stack on it.
item.cardSummary: All Seeing Eye punishes grouped objective pressure. It helps the killer notice when survivors are rushing the same generator.

item.name: Eyes of Hell
item.trigger: Survivor performs a vault
item.effectSummary: Shows loop structures and slows survivors briefly after they vault.
item.cardSummary: Eyes of Hell helps killers read loop routes before survivors use them. It is strongest against window-heavy chases and pallet paths.

item.name: King's Scourge
item.trigger: A generator reaches 90% progress once
item.levelValues: 9/12/15 special skill checks; 5/10/15 seconds repair penalty on failed check
item.statusEffect: Loud sound; generator pause; Vulnerable; regression
item.effectSummary: Turns near-finished generators into a skill-check trap with regression and survivor punishment on failure.
item.cardSummary: King's Scourge is heavy generator pressure. It is best when survivors are close to finishing objectives and one failed check can swing the repair back.

item.name: Trade Off
item.trigger: Trial start and survivor saves from normal spikes
item.levelValues: Highest-progress generator aura reveal for 4/8/12 seconds
item.statusEffect: Cursed spike aura; generator aura reveal
item.effectSummary: Creates cursed spikes and reveals high-progress generator information when survivors interact with spike states.
item.cardSummary: Trade Off turns rescue pressure into map information. It helps killers connect spike saves to generator patrol decisions.

item.name: Deep Wound
item.trigger: Survivor is unspiked from a cursed spike
item.effectSummary: Spawns cursed spikes that punish rescues with anti-heal and more blood pools.
item.cardSummary: Deep Wound makes cursed spike saves hurt more. It is pressure for killers who want rescues to create a healing problem afterward.

item.name: Exposure Therapy
item.trigger: Damage survivors, then survivors finish a heal in terror radius
item.levelValues: 3/4/5 extra seconds of Vulnerable per token consumed
item.cooldownOrLimit: 30 second cooldown; up to 8 tokens; consumes up to 4 tokens
item.effectSummary: Builds damage tokens, then punishes healing inside terror radius with Vulnerable and aura reveal.
item.cardSummary: Exposure Therapy is for killers who keep survivors injured and nearby. It makes rushed healing inside terror radius much riskier.

item.name: Murderous Acrobatics
item.trigger: Vault a window in chase once every 60 seconds
item.effectSummary: Lets the killer vault faster in chase and gain a short haste boost afterward.
item.cardSummary: Murderous Acrobatics gives killers a chase tool around windows. It helps when a survivor expects the vault to buy more time than it actually does.

item.name: Stage Fright
item.trigger: Your aura is revealed to a survivor
item.levelValues: 5/6/7% speed boost for the reveal duration
item.effectSummary: Turns survivor aura reveals into a speed boost for the killer.
item.cardSummary: Stage Fright punishes information perks and items that reveal the killer. It can turn a survivor read into a faster chase if the reveal lasts long enough.

item.name: Containment
item.trigger: Killer vaults a window
item.cooldownOrLimit: Blocks the window for 16 seconds; killer can still vault it
item.effectSummary: Speeds up killer vaults and blocks the window for survivors after vaulting.
item.cardSummary: Containment is a route-control perk. It helps close off a window after the killer uses it, forcing survivors to find another path.

item.name: Touch Of Death
item.trigger: Killer vaults a window to apply Touch of Death
item.cooldownOrLimit: Up to 2 affected windows at the same time
item.statusEffect: Vulnerable; aura reveal; faster killer vault on affected windows
item.effectSummary: Marks up to two windows. Survivors who vault a marked window become Vulnerable and briefly reveal aura.
item.cardSummary: Touch Of Death makes chosen windows dangerous for survivors. It rewards killers who know which routes survivors are likely to use next.
